Git
Jupyter Notebook
Jupyter Lab
Jupyter Lab Extension
Jupyter Book
```

1. Clone the repo
```
git clone https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant.git
```

2. Navigate to the Open-Assistant directory
```
cd Open-Assistant
```

3. Install dependencies
```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

4. Start the development server
```
jupyter notebook
```

5. Open http://localhost:8000/ in your browser to view the app.

### Usage

A list of examples for how to use this project

1. Open the notebook and start typing questions
2. Answer the questions based on the available data

# Open-Assistant

[Open Assistant](https://projects.laion.ai/Open-Assistant/) is a large language model that can be used to generate text in a variety of domains. It is trained on a large corpus of text and can be fine-tuned on specific domains. Open Assistant is available as a web service and can be used from a web browser.

## Getting Started

To use Open Assistant, you need to install the Open Assistant web service. You can do this by following these steps:

1. Install Node.js and npm (Node Package Manager) if you haven't already.
2. Clone the Open Assistant repository:

```
git clone https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant.git
```

3. Navigate to the Open Assistant directory:

```
cd Open-Assistant
```

4. Install the dependencies:

```
npm install
```

5. Start the Open Assistant web service:

```
npm start
```

6. Open http://localhost:3000 in your web browser to use Open Assistant.

## Contributing

Pull requests and issues are welcome. For major changes, please open an issue first to discuss what you would like to change.

Please make sure to update tests as appropriate.
